Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates radiolucent streaks of air outlining the mediastinal structures (pneumomediastinum), which, in the context of chest pain and neck swelling after an alcoholic binge (suggesting vomiting/retching), supports a diagnosis related to alveolar rupture or esophageal injury manifesting as mediastinal air. Among the choices, identifying pneumomediastinum is the most accurate radiographic description.
